{{Quote|It became clear after the lost city of Aurum was destroyed that Tython was too dangerous for those who could not use the Force.|[[Ketu]]|<ref name="DOTJ 1" />}}
'''Aurum''', later known as the '''lost city of Aurum''', was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] that was built by the [[Tythan]]s, the settlers brought to Tython by the [[Tho Yor]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in [[36,453 BBY]]. Over a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Tho Yor Arrival]], Aurum was destroyed during a [[Force Storm (Tython)|Force Storm]], a powerful phenomenon that cause fierce weather and seismic activity on Tython. The city's destruction and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of many non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Tythans was a major factor in the decision that all non-Force-sensitives should [[Second migration|leave Tython]] and settle the other planets in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]].<ref name="DOTJ 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aurum was first mentioned in [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] published on [[February 15]], [[2012]]. The destruction of a city is shown on the page preceding Aurum's mention during [[Je'daii Master]] [[Ketu]]'s narration, but it is not specified whether the city was Aurum.<ref name="DOTJ 1" />
